decisions.reason: The E/L cap-height alignment and second-V right-arm hierarchy were already established in this Requirement by message 171. Message 173 defers further composition refinement but does not introduce a new composition value beyond the existing state.

The source changes the construction and scale of the second V. Its reference to E/L height concerns composition alignment and does not alter the current custom construction or architectural language of the internal letterforms.
The source requires the second V to preserve the Hero V geometry but does not change the É accent's existing derivation, copy precision, peak alignment, or revision policy.
The approved Hero V is used as the unchanged scaling reference for the second V. No Hero V attribute is modified or removed.
Preserving the Hero V's geometry and character in the proportionally scaled second V is consistent with the existing unified-terminal rule and does not establish a new terminal treatment.
The source addresses second-V geometry and hierarchy only and does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its design sequence.
The source supplies a concrete second-V construction rule without changing the broader brand character, positioning, or expression hierarchy.
Refining the supporting second V does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
